about: A sign-in is spent only by an ACCEPTED answer. A refused answer (forged, garbled, for another challenge) is recorded and the sign-in stays open until its window ends, so nobody who has seen a QR code can burn a person's sign-in by posting to it. Run from Go (identity-agent-core/server, the callback route) and TypeScript (IdentityAgentVerifier.handleCallback).

answers.genuine: the person's own signed answer to this challenge
answers.tampered-signature: the genuine answer with its signature altered
answers.wrong-nonce: signed by the person, but for a nonce this challenge did not issue
answers.wrong-audience: signed by the person, but for another audience

outcomes.accepted: the answer is taken and the sign-in is spent
outcomes.refused: the answer is turned away and the sign-in is as it was
outcomes.already-spent: the sign-in was already spent by an accepted answer, so nothing more is taken

sequences.name: a genuine answer alone is accepted
a forged answer does not burn the sign-in
an answer for another challenge does not burn the sign-in
any number of refused answers leave it open
an accepted answer cannot be accepted again
once spent, a refused answer changes nothing
a refused answer before and after an accepted one
